title: OneCLI – OSS credential gateway that keeps secrets out of AI agents
claim: Show HN: OneCLI – OSS credential gateway that keeps secrets out of AI agents
why_good: As AI adoption increases, the need for secure credential management in AI applications becomes critical, creating a niche market.
value: Businesses that integrate AI solutions will pay for a subscription service to ensure their sensitive data remains secure and compliant.
risk: If larger cloud providers implement similar features, OneCLI may struggle to compete with their established user bases and resources.
